name: GlobalFoundries Burlington/Essex Junction Fab9 SiGe expansion
finding: Official GlobalFoundries/Marvell announcement confirms a multi-year agreement to expand SiGe manufacturing capacity at existing Burlington facility.
missing: new utility service or interconnection application

name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems SPARC / Devens campus
finding: Official site confirms built manufacturing/research facilities and SPARC under construction. SPARC is not a grid-connected electricity-producing power plant.

name: Electric Hydrogen Devens electrolyzer gigafactory
finding: Company confirms factory opening. Published1.2GW is annual electrolyzer manufacturing capacity, not this customer's electric load.

name: Sublime Systems Holyoke electrochemical cement facility
finding: DOE confirms planned ultra-low-carbon cement manufacturing facility. Later news indicates a pause but current company/utility primary status and interconnection evidence were not established.
